title: The Fate of the Skaal
description: After encountering Miraak in the Temple of Miraak, Frea leads the Dragonborn to Skaal Village to consult the shaman Storn Crag-Strider. Storn reveals that Miraak has enslaved the Skaal through the All-Maker Stones and sends the Dragonborn to learn the Bend Will shout at Saering's Watch, then use it to free the Skaal at the Wind Stone.

base_facts: I am a Skaal warrior and the daughter of Storn Crag-Strider.
My people are enslaved by Miraak, forced to work at the Wind Stone against their will.
I found the Dragonborn in the Temple of Miraak after they read the Black Book.

ARRIVE_AT_SKAAL_VILLAGE: I have brought the Dragonborn to Skaal Village to seek my father's wisdom about Miraak.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Quest completes; Storn directs player to cleanse remaining stones and seek Neloth.
The villagers will then return to Skaal Village, as should you to report back to Storn.
For the next step in weakening Miraak, he will task you with cleansing the rest of the shrines all over Solsteim, thus starting the quest Cleansing the Stones .

base_facts: I am the Skaal shaman, maintaining the magical barrier that protects Skaal Village from Miraak's influence.
Miraak has enslaved the Skaal through the All-Maker Stones.
The Temple of Miraak was destroyed by dragons long ago, but Miraak survived and has returned.

CONSULT_STORN: The Dragonborn must learn the Word of Power at Saering's Watch to break Miraak's hold on the Skaal.
REPORT_TO_STORN: The Dragonborn has learned Bend Will and must use it on the Wind Stone to free my people.
DEFEAT_LURKER_AND_REPORT: The Skaal are free from Miraak's control. The Dragonborn is an ally of the Skaal.
The Dragonborn must cleanse the remaining All-Maker Stones and seek out Neloth in Tel Mithryn for knowledge of the Black Books.

beats.comment: Player accompanies Frea to Skaal Village after the Temple of Miraak encounter.
Player speaks with Storn, who explains Miraak's influence and sends them to Saering's Watch.

keywords: how can I help the Skaal

beats.comment: Player travels to Saering's Watch and learns the first word of Bend Will from the Word Wall.
Player reports learning Bend Will to Storn, who instructs them to use it on the Wind Stone.
Player uses Bend Will on the Wind Stone to free the enslaved Skaal villagers.
Player defeats the Lurker released from the Wind Stone and returns to Storn, who names them an ally of the Skaal.
Quest completes; Storn directs player to cleanse remaining stones and seek Neloth.
